verdict.rationale: Orama Cloud offers on-premise deployment of its context server on your own infrastructure, delivered in your cloud, on-prem or dedicated with Orama's forward-deployed engineers (orama-docs-8, orama-docs-51). The open-source engine is self-hostable and its APIs are designed to be close to Cloud's (orama-docs-12, orama-docs-19). However, open-source features still lean on the hosted service: AnswerSession proxies queries through Orama Cloud's Secure Proxy (orama-docs-18). Cloud-only features, such as the per-project MCP server and automatic local-model embeddings, have no documented self-host equivalent. missing for 10: evidence of feature parity between self-hosted and hosted, self-service on-prem deployment docs (install, scaling, ops), self-hosted MCP server and embedding generation, independent or hands-on corroboration of on-prem deployments.
